gnss_poser.$comment: HH_260812 - Define the configurable legacy-map correction and its safe zero-offset defaults.

gnss_ins_orientation_timeout_sec.description: Maximum timestamp difference between a fix and INS attitude. [s]

gnss_ins_orientation_fix_frame.description: Fix frame allowed to use the INS attitude.

allow_position_only_fallback.description: Publish a broad-yaw position seed when primary INS attitude is unavailable.

course_heading_min_distance_m.description: Minimum displacement before updating fallback course heading. [m]

position_only_yaw_stddev_rad.description: Yaw standard deviation for position-only output. [rad]

projected_position_offset_enabled.description: Subtract a calibrated translation after map projection and antenna-to-base conversion. Disable for a natively georeferenced map bundle.

projected_position_offset_x_m.description: Calibrated projected x translation to subtract. [m]

projected_position_offset_y_m.description: Calibrated projected y translation to subtract. [m]

projected_position_offset_z_m.description: Calibrated projected z translation to subtract. [m]

gnss_pose_pub_method.description: 0: Instant Value 1: Average Value 2: Median Value. If 0 is chosen buffer_epoch parameter loses affect.
